conditions.initial_geometry: same archived 28 ps classical endpoint; independent 100 ps preparation with distinct seeds
conditions.production: NVE, fresh canonical momenta per segment, total COM momentum removed once per segment
conditions.sampling_thermostat: global canonical Maxwell momentum refresh every 100 fs; Andersen heat-bath scheme

engine: OpenMM VerletIntegrator external reference with synchronized physical velocities

estimators.primary: molecular COM VACF integral/3 to 2 ps, all segments equally weighted
estimators.raw_precision: float32 COM positions/velocities and oxygen positions, float64 scalar observations and restart q/p; quantify storage error separately
estimators.secondary: molecular COM MSD slope/6 from 1 to 2 ps
estimators.uncertainty: Student t interval of equally weighted chain means (df=chains-1); within-chain blocking separately
estimators.uncertainty_unit: independent seed chain; no molecule/time-origin/segment independence assumption

fixed_stage.stop_rule: Complete the fixed stage or checkpoint at a declared compute budget. Never stop, extend, select or discard trajectories based on closeness to the reference value.

limitations: External OpenMM reference is not a PyRPMD production trajectory.
800 ps fixed production stage versus 8000 ps in the paper.
Common initial geometry requires adequate new preparation and chain mixing diagnostics.
Printed parameters and declared masses can differ slightly from original unpublished executable inputs.
No quantum diffusion or PA-CMD IR claim follows from classical agreement.

literature_comparison.use: Report difference and combined uncertainty after eligibility checks; target proximity never determines stopping or selection.

additional_reviews: timestep uncertainty explicitly unresolved without an independent property comparison
predeclared_eligibility_checks.cutoff_and_estimator_difference_threshol: larger of 0.01 A^2/ps and 95% paired-chain CI halfwidth; inspect all prespecified windows without excluding failed segments
